sanskrit: sarvathaiva mahārāja śarīraṃ dhārayed iha pretyeha caiva kartavyam ātmaniḥśreyasaṃ param
english: In every way, great king, one should sustain the body here below; for both this world and the next, the highest good of the self is to be pursued.

sanskrit: evaṃ kurvañ śubhā vāco loke 'smiñ śṛṇute nṛpaḥ pretya svargaṃ tathāpnoti prajā dharmeṇa pālayan
english: Acting thus, the king hears words of praise in this world, and in the next attains heaven by guarding his subjects with righteousness.

sanskrit: evaṃ tvayā kuruśreṣṭha vartitavyaṃ prajāhitam ubhayor lokayos tāta prāptaye nityam eva ca
english: Thus, O best of the Kurus, you must ever conduct yourself for the welfare of your subjects, my son, so as to win both worlds.

sanskrit: bhīṣmeṇa pūrvam ukto 'si kṛṣṇena vidureṇa ca mayāpy avaśyaṃ vaktavyaṃ prītyā te nṛpasattama
english: You were instructed before by Bhīṣma, by Kṛṣṇa, and by Vidura; and I too must needs speak, out of love for you, O best of kings.

sanskrit: etat sarvaṃ yathānyāyaṃ kurvīthā bhūridakṣiṇa priyas tathā prajānāṃ tvaṃ svarge sukham avāpsyasi
english: Do all this according to right, O giver of abundant gifts; thus, dear to your subjects, you shall win happiness in heaven.

sanskrit: aśvamedhasahasreṇa yo yajet pṛthivīpatiḥ pālayed vāpi dharmeṇa prajās tulyaṃ phalaṃ labhet
english: Whether a lord of the earth offers a thousand horse-sacrifices or guards his subjects with righteousness, he reaps an equal fruit.

sanskrit: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca evam etat kariṣyāmi yathāttha pṛthivīpate bhūyaś caivānuśāsyo 'haṃ bhavatā pārthivarṣabha
english: Yudhiṣṭhira said: I shall do all this just as you have spoken, O lord of the earth; and I am ever to be further instructed by you, O bull among kings.

sanskrit: bhīṣme svargam anuprāpte gate ca madhusūdane vidure saṃjaye caiva ko 'nyo māṃ vaktum arhati
english: Now that Bhīṣma has gone to heaven, that the Slayer of Madhu has departed, and Vidura and Saṃjaya as well, who else is fit to counsel me?

sanskrit: yat tu mām anuśāstīha bhavān adya hite sthitaḥ kartāsmy etan mahīpāla nirvṛto bhava bhārata
english: Whatever you, set upon my good, instruct me here this day, that I shall do, O guardian of the earth; be at ease, O Bhārata.

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca evam uktaḥ sa rājarṣir dharmarājena dhīmatā kaunteyaṃ samanujñātum iyeṣa bharatarṣabha
english: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: Thus addressed by the wise King of Righteousness, that royal sage wished to take his leave of the son of Kuntī, O bull of the Bharatas.

sanskrit: putra viśramyatāṃ tāvan mamāpi balavāñ śramaḥ ity uktvā prāviśad rājā gāndhāryā bhavanaṃ tadā
english: "My son, let there be rest awhile; my weariness too is great" — so saying, the king then entered the chamber of Gāndhārī.

sanskrit: tam āsanagataṃ devī gāndhārī dharmacāriṇī uvāca kāle kālajñā prajāpatisamaṃ patim
english: When he had taken his seat, the queen Gāndhārī, faithful to her duty and knowing the fitting moment, addressed her husband, who was the equal of Prajāpati.

sanskrit: anujñātaḥ svayaṃ tena vyāsenāpi maharṣiṇā yudhiṣṭhirasyānumate kadāraṇyaṃ gamiṣyasi
english: "Granted leave by the great sage Vyāsa himself, and with Yudhiṣṭhira's consent, when will you depart to the forest?"

sanskrit: dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca gāndhāry aham anujñātaḥ svayaṃ pitrā mahātmanā yudhiṣṭhirasyānumate gantāsmi nacirād vanam
english: Dhṛtarāṣṭra said: Gāndhārī, granted leave by my great-souled father himself, and with Yudhiṣṭhira's consent, I shall go to the forest before long.

sanskrit: ahaṃ hi nāma sarveṣāṃ teṣāṃ durdyūtadevinām putrāṇāṃ dātum icchāmi pretyabhāvānugaṃ vasu sarvaprakṛtisāṃnidhyaṃ kārayitvā svaveśmani
english: For I wish, in the presence of all my subjects gathered in my house, to bestow upon all those sons of mine who gamed at the wicked dice the wealth that follows them into the life beyond.

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca ity uktvā dharmarājāya preṣayām āsa pārthivaḥ sa ca tadvacanāt sarvaṃ samāninye mahīpatiḥ
english: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: Having spoken thus, the king sent word to the King of Righteousness; and at his word the lord of the earth had everything brought together.

sanskrit: tato niṣkramya nṛpatis tasmād antaḥpurāt tadā sarvaṃ suhṛjjanaṃ caiva sarvāś ca prakṛtīs tathā samavetāṃś ca tān sarvān paurajānapadān atha
english: Then the king came forth from that inner apartment, and gathered all his kinsfolk and friends, all his subjects, and all the assembled people of the city and the countryside.

sanskrit: brāhmaṇāṃś ca mahīpālān nānādeśasamāgatān tataḥ prāha mahātejā dhṛtarāṣṭro mahīpatiḥ
english: And to the brāhmaṇas and to the rulers gathered from many lands, the mighty-splendored Dhṛtarāṣṭra, lord of the earth, then spoke.

sanskrit: śṛṇvanty ekāgramanaso brāhmaṇāḥ kurujāṅgalāḥ kṣatriyāś caiva vaiśyāś ca śūdrāś caiva samāgatāḥ
english: "Listen with single-minded attention, you brāhmaṇas of Kurujāṅgala, and you kṣatriyas, vaiśyas, and śūdras here assembled."

sanskrit: bhavantaḥ kuravaś caiva bahukālaṃ sahoṣitāḥ parasparasya suhṛdaḥ parasparahite ratāḥ
english: "You and the Kurus have dwelt together for a long time, friends to one another and devoted to one another's good."

sanskrit: yad idānīm ahaṃ brūyām asmin kāla upasthite tathā bhavadbhiḥ kartavyam avicārya vaco mama
english: "Whatever I now say, this hour being come, that you must do without questioning my word."

sanskrit: araṇyagamane buddhir gāndhārīsahitasya me vyāsasyānumate rājñas tathā kuntīsutasya ca bhavanto 'py anujānantu mā vo 'nyā bhūd vicāraṇā
english: "My mind, together with Gāndhārī's, is set upon going to the forest, with the consent of Vyāsa, of the king, and of the son of Kuntī. Do you too grant me leave; let no other doubt arise in you."

sanskrit: asmākaṃ bhavatāṃ caiva yeyaṃ prītir hi śāśvatī na cānyeṣv asti deśeṣu rājñām iti matir mama
english: "The love that is between us and you is everlasting; nowhere else among the kingdoms, I think, does such a bond between kings exist."

sanskrit: śrānto 'smi vayasānena tathā putravinākṛtaḥ upavāsakṛśaś cāsmi gāndhārīsahito 'naghāḥ
english: "I am wearied by old age and bereft of my sons; I am wasted by fasting, together with Gāndhārī, O sinless ones."

sanskrit: yudhiṣṭhiragate rājye prāptaś cāsmi sukhaṃ mahat manye duryodhanaiśvaryād viśiṣṭam iti sattamāḥ
english: "With the kingdom passed to Yudhiṣṭhira, I have attained great happiness — greater, I deem, than under Duryodhana's sovereignty, O most excellent men."

sanskrit: mama tv andhasya vṛddhasya hataputrasya kā gatiḥ ṛte vanaṃ mahābhāgās tan mānujñātum arhatha
english: "But for me, blind and aged and bereft of my sons, what refuge is there save the forest, O blessed ones? Therefore grant me leave."

sanskrit: tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā sarve te kurujāṅgalāḥ bāṣpasaṃdigdhayā vācā rurudur bharatarṣabha
english: Hearing those words of his, all the people of Kurujāṅgala wept, their voices choked with tears, O bull of the Bharatas.

sanskrit: tān avibruvataḥ kiṃ cid duḥkhaśokaparāyaṇān punar eva mahātejā dhṛtarāṣṭro 'bravīd idam
english: To them, who could utter nothing, sunk in grief and sorrow, the mighty-splendored Dhṛtarāṣṭra spoke once again these words.

sanskrit: dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca śaṃtanuḥ pālayām āsa yathāvat pṛthivīm imām tathā vicitravīryaś ca bhīṣmeṇa paripālitaḥ pālayām āsa vas tāto viditaṃ vo nasaṃśayaḥ
english: Dhṛtarāṣṭra said: Śaṃtanu duly guarded this earth, and Vicitravīrya too, sheltered by Bhīṣma, ruled over you as a father — this you know beyond all doubt.

sanskrit: yathā ca pāṇḍur bhrātā me dayito bhavatām abhūt sa cāpi pālayām āsa yathāvat tac ca vettha ha
english: And how my brother Pāṇḍu was beloved of you, and how he too ruled rightly — that too you well know.

sanskrit: mayā ca bhavatāṃ samyak chuśrūṣā yā kṛtānaghāḥ asamyag vā mahābhāgās tat kṣantavyam atandritaiḥ
english: And whatever service I rendered you, well done or ill done, O sinless and blessed ones, that you must forgive, being free of resentment.

sanskrit: yac ca duryodhanenedaṃ rājyaṃ bhuktam akaṇṭakam api tatra na vo mando durbuddhir aparāddhavān
english: And in the kingdom that Duryodhana enjoyed unopposed, even there that dull-witted, evil-minded one did you no wrong.

sanskrit: tasyāparādhād durbuddher abhimānān mahīkṣitām vimardaḥ sumahān āsīd anayān matkṛtād atha
english: Through the offense of that evil-minded one, through the arrogance of the rulers of the earth, and through the misdeeds wrought by me, there arose a most terrible carnage.

sanskrit: tan mayā sādhu vāpīdaṃ yadi vāsādhu vai kṛtam tad vo hṛdi na kartavyaṃ mām anujñātum arhatha
english: Whether what was done by me was well or ill, you must not hold it in your hearts; grant me your leave.

sanskrit: vṛddho 'yaṃ hataputro 'yaṃ duḥkhito 'yaṃ janādhipaḥ pūrvarājñāṃ ca putro 'yam iti kṛtvānujānata
english: "This man is old, bereft of his sons, this lord of men is stricken with grief, and he is the son of the kings of old" — bearing this in mind, grant me leave.

sanskrit: iyaṃ ca kṛpaṇā vṛddhā hataputrā tapasvinī gāndhārī putraśokārtā tulyaṃ yācati vo mayā
english: And this poor aged Gāndhārī, bereft of her sons, ascetic and wretched, tormented by grief for her children, entreats you together with me.

sanskrit: hataputrāv imau vṛddhau viditvā duḥkhitau tathā anujānīta bhadraṃ vo vrajāvaḥ śaraṇaṃ ca vaḥ
english: Knowing us two to be old and bereft of our sons and afflicted, grant us leave — blessings upon you — that we may depart; and you are our refuge.

sanskrit: ayaṃ ca kauravo rājā kuntīputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ sarvair bhavadbhir draṣṭavyaḥ sameṣu viṣameṣu ca na jātu viṣamaṃ caiva gamiṣyati kadā cana
english: And this Kaurava king, Yudhiṣṭhira son of Kuntī, is to be regarded by you all in fair fortune and in foul; nor will he ever at any time turn to wrong.

sanskrit: catvāraḥ sacivā yasya bhrātaro vipulaujasaḥ lokapālopamā hy ete sarve dharmārthadarśinaḥ
english: His four brothers, of vast might, are his counselors; like the guardians of the world are they all, beholders of righteousness and gain.

sanskrit: brahmeva bhagavān eṣa sarvabhūtajagatpatiḥ yudhiṣṭhiro mahātejā bhavataḥ pālayiṣyati
english: Like the lord Brahmā, master of all beings and of the world, the mighty-splendored Yudhiṣṭhira will protect you.

sanskrit: avaśyam eva vaktavyam iti kṛtvā bravīmi vaḥ eṣa nyāso mayā dattaḥ sarveṣāṃ vo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ bhavanto 'sya ca vīrasya nyāsabhūtā mayā kṛtāḥ
english: Because it must needs be said, I say it to you: as a trust I give Yudhiṣṭhira to you all, and you I make a trust given over to that hero.

sanskrit: yady eva taiḥ kṛtaṃ kiṃ cid vyalīkaṃ vā sutair mama yady anyena madīyena tad anujñātum arhatha
english: If any wrong was done by them, my sons, or by any other of mine, that too you must forgive.

sanskrit: bhavadbhir hi na me manyuḥ kṛtapūrvaḥ kathaṃ cana atyantagurubhaktānām eṣo 'ñjalir idaṃ namaḥ
english: For you have never in any way before stirred my wrath; to you, ever most devoted to your elders, are these folded hands, this salutation.

sanskrit: teṣām asthirabuddhīnāṃ lubdhānāṃ kāmacāriṇām kṛte yācāmi vaḥ sarvān gāndhārīsahito 'naghāḥ
english: For the sake of those fickle-minded, greedy ones who followed their own desires, I beseech you all, together with Gāndhārī, O sinless ones.

sanskrit: ity uktās tena te rājñā paurajānapadā janāḥ nocur bāṣpakalāḥ kiṃ cid vīkṣāṃ cakruḥ parasparam
english: Thus addressed by that king, the people of the city and countryside, faltering with tears, said nothing, but looked upon one another.

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca evam uktās tu te tena paurajānapadā janāḥ vṛddhena rājñā kauravya naṣṭasaṃjñā ivābhavan
english: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: Thus addressed by the aged king, the people of the city and countryside became, O Kaurava, as though robbed of their senses.

sanskrit: tūṣṇīṃbhūtāṃs tatas tāṃs tu bāṣpakaṇṭhān mahīpatiḥ dhṛtarāṣṭro mahīpālaḥ punar evābhyabhāṣata
english: Then to them, fallen silent with throats choked by tears, the lord of the earth, King Dhṛtarāṣṭra, spoke yet again.

sanskrit: vṛddhaṃ māṃ hataputraṃ ca dharmapatnyā sahānayā vilapantaṃ bahuvidhaṃ kṛpaṇaṃ caiva sattamāḥ
english: "Old am I, and bereft of my sons, lamenting in many ways and pitiably, together with this my lawful wife, O most excellent men."

sanskrit: pitrā svayam anujñātaṃ kṛṣṇadvaipāyanena vai vanavāsāya dharmajñā dharmajñena nṛpeṇa ca
english: "Granted leave for life in the forest by my father Kṛṣṇa Dvaipāyana himself, and by the righteous king who knows the law, O knowers of righteousness —"

sanskrit: so 'haṃ punaḥ punar yāce śirasāvanato 'naghāḥ gāndhāryā sahitaṃ tan māṃ samanujñātum arhatha
english: "— I, bowing my head, beseech you again and again, O sinless ones: grant leave to me, together with Gāndhārī."

sanskrit: śrutvā tu kururājasya vākyāni karuṇāni te ruruduḥ sarvato rājan sametāḥ kurujāṅgalāḥ
english: Hearing these piteous words of the Kuru king, the gathered people of Kurujāṅgala wept on every side, O king.

sanskrit: uttarīyaiḥ karaiś cāpi saṃchādya vadanāni te ruruduḥ śokasaṃtaptā muhūrtaṃ pitṛmātṛvat
english: Covering their faces with their upper garments and with their hands, they wept awhile, scorched with sorrow, as for a father and a mother.

sanskrit: hṛdayaiḥ śūnyabhūtais te dhṛtarāṣṭrapravāsajam duḥkhaṃ saṃdhārayantaḥ sma naṣṭasaṃjñā ivābhavan
english: With hearts grown empty, bearing the grief born of Dhṛtarāṣṭra's departure, they became as though bereft of their senses.

sanskrit: te vinīya tam āyāsaṃ kururājaviyogajam śanaiḥ śanais tadānyonyam abruvan svamatāny uta
english: Having mastered that anguish born of parting from the Kuru king, little by little they then spoke their minds to one another.

sanskrit: tataḥ saṃdhāya te sarve vākyāny atha samāsataḥ ekasmin brāhmaṇe rājann āveśyocur narādhipam
english: Then, having all composed their words together in brief and entrusted them to a single brāhmaṇa, O king, they addressed the lord of men.

sanskrit: tataḥ svacaraṇe vṛddhaḥ saṃmato 'rthaviśāradaḥ sāmbākhyo bahvṛco rājan vaktuṃ samupacakrame
english: Then an aged man, honored in his own conduct, skilled in matters of policy, learned in the Ṛgveda and named Sāmba, O king, began to speak.

sanskrit: anumānya mahārājaṃ tat sadaḥ saṃprabhāṣya ca vipraḥ pragalbho medhāvī sa rājānam uvāca ha
english: Having paid honor to the great king and addressed that assembly, the bold and wise brāhmaṇa spoke thus to the king.

sanskrit: rājan vākyaṃ janasyāsya mayi sarvaṃ samarpitam vakṣyāmi tad ahaṃ vīra taj juṣasva narādhipa
english: "O king, the word of all this people has been wholly entrusted to me; that I shall speak, O hero — receive it kindly, O lord of men."

sanskrit: yathā vadasi rājendra sarvam etat tathā vibho nātra mithyā vacaḥ kiṃ cit suhṛt tvaṃ naḥ parasparam
english: "As you say, O king of kings, so is all this, O mighty one; there is in it no false word at all. You are our friend, and we yours, each to each."

sanskrit: na jātv asya tu vaṃśasya rājñāṃ kaś cit kadā cana rājāsīd yaḥ prajāpālaḥ prajānām apriyo bhavet
english: "Never at any time has there been among the kings of this line one who, as a guardian of his people, became hateful to his subjects."

sanskrit: pitṛvad bhrātṛvac caiva bhavantaḥ pālayanti naḥ na ca duryodhanaḥ kiṃ cid ayuktaṃ kṛtavān nṛpa
english: "As a father and as a brother you have guarded us; nor did Duryodhana do anything unbefitting, O king."

sanskrit: yathā bravīti dharmajño muniḥ satyavatīsutaḥ tathā kuru mahārāja sa hi naḥ paramo guruḥ
english: "As the righteous sage, son of Satyavatī, directs, so do, O great king; for he is our supreme preceptor."

sanskrit: tyaktā vayaṃ tu bhavatā duḥkhaśokaparāyaṇāḥ bhaviṣyāmaś ciraṃ rājan bhavadguṇaśatair hṛtāḥ
english: "But forsaken by you, we shall long be given over to grief and sorrow, O king, captivated by your hundred virtues."

sanskrit: yathā śaṃtanunā guptā rājñā citrāṅgadena ca bhīṣmavīryopagūḍhena pitrā ca tava pārthiva
english: "As we were sheltered by King Śaṃtanu and by Citrāṅgada, and by your father, screened by the valor of Bhīṣma, O lord of the earth —"

sanskrit: bhavadbuddhiyujā caiva pāṇḍunā pṛthivīkṣitā tathā duryodhanenāpi rājñā suparipālitāḥ
english: "— and by Pāṇḍu, ruler of the earth, who shared your wisdom, and by King Duryodhana too, we were well protected."

sanskrit: na svalpam api putras te vyalīkaṃ kṛtavān nṛpa pitarīva suviśvastās tasminn api narādhipe vayam āsma yathā samyag bhavato viditaṃ tathā
english: "Not even a little wrong did your son do us, O king; in that lord of men too we trusted utterly as in a father — even as you well know."

sanskrit: tathā varṣasahasrāya kuntīputreṇa dhīmatā pālyamānā dhṛtimatā sukhaṃ vindāmahe nṛpa
english: "And now, guarded for a thousand years by the wise and steadfast son of Kuntī, we shall find happiness, O king."

sanskrit: rājarṣīṇāṃ purāṇānāṃ bhavatāṃ vaṃśadhāriṇām kurusaṃvaraṇādīnāṃ bharatasya ca dhīmataḥ
english: "Of the royal sages of old, the upholders of your line — Kuru, Saṃvaraṇa and the rest, and the wise Bharata —"

sanskrit: vṛttaṃ samanuyāty eṣa dharmātmā bhūridakṣiṇaḥ nātra vācyaṃ mahārāja susūkṣmam api vidyate
english: "— their conduct does this righteous-souled one, giver of abundant gifts, follow faithfully; herein, O great king, there is not even the subtlest fault to be found."

sanskrit: uṣitāḥ sma sukhaṃ nityaṃ bhavatā paripālitāḥ susūkṣmaṃ ca vyalīkaṃ te saputrasya na vidyate
english: "Guarded by you, we have ever dwelt in happiness; not the subtlest wrong is to be found in you or in your son."

sanskrit: yat tu jñātivimarde 'sminn āttha duryodhanaṃ prati bhavantam anuneṣyāmi tatrāpi kurunandana
english: "But concerning what you have said of Duryodhana in this destruction of kinsmen, in that matter too I shall console you, O delight of the Kurus."

sanskrit: brāhmaṇa uvāca na tad duryodhanakṛtaṃ na ca tad bhavatā kṛtam na karṇasaubalābhyāṃ ca kuravo yat kṣayaṃ gatāḥ
english: The brāhmaṇa said: That the Kurus went to ruin was not Duryodhana's doing, nor yours, nor that of Karṇa and the son of Subala.

sanskrit: daivaṃ tat tu vijānīmo yan na śakyaṃ prabādhitum daivaṃ puruṣakāreṇa na śakyam ativartitum
english: That, we know, was fate, which cannot be turned aside; fate cannot be overcome by human effort.

sanskrit: akṣauhiṇyo mahārāja daśāṣṭau ca samāgatāḥ aṣṭādaśāhena hatā daśabhir yodhapuṃgavaiḥ
english: Eighteen akṣauhiṇīs, great king, came together, and in eighteen days were slain by ten foremost warriors.

sanskrit: bhīṣmadroṇakṛpādyaiś ca karṇena ca mahātmanā yuyudhānena vīreṇa dhṛṣṭadyumnena caiva ha
english: By Bhīṣma, Droṇa, Kṛpa and the rest, by the great-souled Karṇa, by the hero Yuyudhāna, and by Dhṛṣṭadyumna —

sanskrit: caturbhiḥ pāṇḍuputraiś ca bhīmārjunayamair nṛpa janakṣayo 'yaṃ nṛpate kṛto daivabalātkṛtaiḥ
english: — and by the four sons of Pāṇḍu, by Bhīma, Arjuna and the twins, O king — this slaughter of people was wrought by men compelled by the power of fate.

sanskrit: avaśyam eva saṃgrāme kṣatriyeṇa viśeṣataḥ kartavyaṃ nidhanaṃ loke śastreṇa kṣatrabandhunā
english: In the world, a kṣatriya — and above all a man of the warrior breed — must of necessity meet his death in battle, by the weapon.

sanskrit: tair iyaṃ puruṣavyāghrair vidyābāhubalānvitaiḥ pṛthivī nihatā sarvā sahayā sarathadvipā
english: By those tigers among men, endowed with knowledge and strength of arm, this whole earth was struck down, together with its horses, chariots, and elephants.

sanskrit: na sa rājāparādhnoti putras tava mahāmanāḥ na bhavān na ca te bhṛtyā na karṇo na ca saubalaḥ
english: That king, your high-minded son, does no wrong; nor do you, nor your servants, nor Karṇa, nor the son of Subala.

sanskrit: yad vinaṣṭāḥ kuruśreṣṭhā rājānaś ca sahasraśaḥ sarvaṃ daivakṛtaṃ tad vai ko 'tra kiṃ vaktum arhati
english: That the foremost of the Kurus and kings by the thousand perished — all that, in truth, was wrought by fate; who here is fit to say anything of it?
